T: Grown-up food for a kid at heart.
D: A 12-year-old wishes to be big and wakes up as a grown man working at a toy company.
P: Serve the snacks when Josh eats baby corn like a tiny corn cob at the company party.
S: eat it off the cob with both hands, like Josh
Blanch baby corn 2 minutes, then char on a hot griddle with butter, chilli and lime salt. Eat it like a corn cob.
the fancy party snack Josh spits straight back out
Water crackers with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, the fancy party snack Josh can't handle.
M: MacMillan party crab cakes with remoulade
the MacMillan Toys company party where Josh takes on the baby corn

Golden crab cakes packed with sweet crab, bound with a little mayo and crumb, with a sharp caper remoulade and lemon. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, chopped parsley, lemon zest and 60g panko. Shape 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. For the remoulade mix 120g mayonnaise, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 chopped cornichons, 1 tsp Dijon and lemon juice. Serve with salad leaves.
Josh and Billy loose in the city
Simmer franks in water with onion, then griddle until blistered. Steamed buns, yellow mustard, sauerkraut and onions cooked down in tomato paste and vinegar.
W: big enough to play like the floor piano
Brown butter choc chip dough pressed into a pizza tray, baked at 180C for 18 minutes, still soft in the middle, piano keys piped on in icing.
K: a New York fountain drink for a kid in a grown-up's body
Chocolate syrup, cold milk and soda water stirred hard in a tall glass until it foams up.

edition.tagline: Grown-up food for a kid at heart.
edition.cue: Serve the snacks when Josh eats baby corn like a tiny corn cob at the company party.

s.note: Charred baby corn with butter, chilli and lime salt
s.how: Blanch 400g baby corn in salted boiling water for 2 minutes and drain well. Char on a hot griddle for 3 minutes with 30g butter, then sprinkle with chilli flakes, lime zest and salt. Serve with lime wedges and eat it like a cob.

s.note: Crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives on water crackers
s.how: Spread 20 water crackers with a teaspoon of crème fraîche each, about 200ml in total. Top each with half a teaspoon of salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Assemble just before serving so the crackers stay crisp and Josh can spit one out.

m.note: Griddled franks with mustard, sauerkraut and red onion sauce
m.how: Simmer 8 franks in water with half an onion for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Soften 2 sliced onions in oil for 15 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of vinegar. Steam 8 buns, fill and top with mustard and sauerkraut.

w.note: One huge soft cookie with piano keys piped on top
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Press into a pizza tray and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool and pipe white icing piano keys across it.

d.note: Chocolate syrup, cold milk and soda water foamed high.
d.how: For each of 4 tall glasses add 2 tbsp chocolate syrup and 80ml cold milk. Pour in 150ml chilled soda water hard from a height, stirring with a long spoon so a white foam head rises up the glass. Serve with a straw straight away.
